policy.selection: First consecutive season pair satisfying count/night requirements, using timestamps and format only. All observations in each chosen season; no residual clipping.
policy.error_model: Independent reported per-exposure ADES covariance plus a zero-mean common two-dimensional station/UTC-night offset with fixed 0.15 arcsec standard deviation. Illustrative sensitivity model, not an externally calibrated survey error model.
policy.comparison: Independent-error baseline and fixed correlated-night model; both trained on the same early season. Preserve every declared case, including failures. Holdout never chooses a model or error parameter.

T05.note: Rounded published MPC parallax factors compared to the explicit Horizons station coordinates.

T08.note: Rounded published MPC parallax factors compared to the explicit Horizons station coordinates.

provenance.dependency: Measured target angles from MPC; only observers/UTC-TDB/perturbers from JPL DE441/EOP. No target orbit requested.
